description: Robot-in-a-Box unfold animation sequence. Timing and labels only; positions and paths live in src/viewer/fold/layout.js

sequence.name: Detach Feet from Lid
sequence.notes: Feet start stacked on the closed lid; taken off top-first and hung on the outside of their wall

sequence.name: Open Lid
sequence.notes: Lid hinges on the top edge of the front wall and swings 180 degrees out toward the viewer

sequence.name: Lift Stiffeners Out of Box
sequence.notes: Stiffener rack under the lid is lifted out onto the floor beside the box

sequence.name: Fold Down All Side Panels
sequence.notes: All 4 walls fold down together, carrying their feet, clamps and mounted parts; the open lid stays level and lands beyond the front wall

sequence.name: Deploy Side Struts
sequence.notes: Struts with their handles are lifted out of the box and stood up on the side panels

sequence.name: Insert Stiffeners
sequence.notes: Stiffeners move from the floor into their slots across the fold lines

sequence.name: Set Up Shelf and TV
sequence.notes: Shelf stands up on the back panel; tripod and TV are placed behind it

sequence.name: Move PC to Final Position
sequence.notes: PC moves onto the right panel

sequence.name: Place Keyboard and Mouse
sequence.notes: Keyboard and mouse slide onto the shelf

sequence.name: Robot Arm to Working Position
sequence.notes: UR30 base joint swings the arm from its packed pose to the working pose

colors.enhancements: Add PBR properties (metallic, roughness) to STEP colors for realistic rendering
